svg.title: Does sequence context improve goal prediction?
svg.desc: Wyscout England 2017/18 · 12,000 held-out states · 103 score-positive and 14 concede-positive states Intervals: 95% paired match bootstrap, conditional on fitted models. Negative differences favour GRU. *xT + location uses extra training events. Model search and compute budgets differ.
